Drop table dw.DimCustomerNameURL_IBG1_UT;

select 
    concat(dc.customername, ' - ',dc.customerid) as NameID,
    dc.customerid as CustomerID,
    case when dc.customertype in('Retail','RETAIL') then concat('https://app.powerbi.com/groups/864e885b-7b30-4568-9278-5a3d0be9c0ac/reports/6a8099e7-fcad-49e3-9914-c3e964e65306/ReportSection74790b99f3cb412fcc52','?filter=Customer/CustomerID eq ''',dc.customerid,'''') 
            ELSE  concat('https://app.powerbi.com/groups/864e885b-7b30-4568-9278-5a3d0be9c0ac/reports/d461ce27-19ce-4a7d-ab31-287ef8c18808/ReportSection74790b99f3cb412fcc52','?filter=Customer/CustomerID eq ''',dc.customerid,'''')
     END as URL
into dw.DimCustomerNameURL_IBG1_UT
from dw.dimcustomernametest dc
WHERE DC.CustomerID IN(Select Distinct CustomerID from DW.DimCustomer DC
    WHERE DC.CustomerSK IN(
        Select distinct CustomerSK from dw.DimInstitutionalBankingGroupList))
